_meta.description: Warlord subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: hybrid ATK/DEF, debuff control, off-tank survivability.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +0.5% ATK et +0.5% armure par niveau. Une ligne qui voit son chef debout tient plus longtemps.
subclass_passives.description_en: +0.5% ATK and +0.5% armor per level. A line that sees its leader standing holds longer.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1 durée des améliorations et +0.5% précision par niveau. Le plan ne survit pas au premier contact, mais l'ordre, si.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1 buff duration and +0.5% accuracy per level. The plan does not survive first contact, but the order does.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1% PV max, +0,5% réduction de dégâts et +8% résistance magique par rang.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1% max HP, +0.5% damage reduction and +8% magic resistance per rank.
